about: Type-to-filter over a row's `find` words: each find word folded for case and accents and split on every character that is not a letter or a digit; what is typed folded the same and split on spaces; each typed word split on the same characters, and every piece found: a run of digits inside some find word as the home sent it, anything else at the start of some split find word. A typed word with no piece finds nothing; nothing typed shows every row. Written by hand; the dashboard's lib/words.js found and the phone's PageFilter.shows read it case by case.
